## Earnie 2.5.0

Official **2.5.0** after the community alpha line (`2.5.0-alpha.*`). Focus: **15‑minute MILP horizon**, tariff settlement fidelity, Hauskonfigurator / Smarthome-Backend UX, and release hardening.

### Highlights

- **Quarter-hour MILP** — full `dt_h = 0.25` planning window, flex slot math, QH charts and cons_data; decision brief [`docs/spec/quarter-hour-slots.md`](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/docs/spec/quarter-hour-slots.md)
- **Tariffs** — `settlement_mtu` on the full DACH catalog; hourly-settlement products use EPEX average rule where applicable
- **Hauskonfigurator** — battery wear editable on Batterien tab; profile delete; planning UX improvements
- **Smarthome-Backend** — dedicated SB page; Loxone Anbindung on SB; hardened `.env` save on NAS
- **EHAL-Com** — clearer Loud/Silent status banner vs optimizer daemon; primary setting `silent_mode` in `local_settings.json`
- **Quality** — `2.5.r` hardening + pre-official re-check (2279 tests, ~81% coverage); SonarCloud CI on `main`

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.0`
- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:latest`
- Legacy aliases: `ghcr.io/jochentcc/ernie-energy:2.5.0` / `:latest`

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

Deploy: [docs/einrichtung/container.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/docs/einrichtung/container.md)

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml up -d
```

(Same pattern for `loxberry_productive.yml` / `proxmox_productive.yml`.)

### Carry-over

- Alpha compose files remain pinned to the last pre-release (`2.5.0-alpha.9`) for community testers
- Next roadmap: **2.6** (EEG POC) and **2.+1** improvements

See [backlog/Backlog.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/backlog/Backlog.md) · [backlog/Backlog-Bugfixes.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/backlog/Backlog-Bugfixes.md).
